summary: Locked, Nix-resolved dependencies for Neovim and lazy.nvim.

values.language_tooling_setup: Start the supplied `nvim` wrapper to activate the pinned lazy.nvim manager and readonly plugin tree. It preserves the normal lazy.nvim bootstrap path while keeping caches and mutable editor state private. `LAZY_PURIFIER_PROJECT` selects the configuration repository; native dependency checks prevent an ambient plugin checkout from replacing a locked dependency.
